# BookLeaf Support Portal

- Build a secure full-stack application using React with JavaScript (Vite), Node.js/Express with JavaScript, and MongoDB Atlas via Mongoose.
- Keep author and admin experiences role-protected; enforce access checks in every API route.
- Keep AI credentials server-side in environment variables and provide graceful fallbacks.
- Use the BookLeaf policies in the product brief for all drafted support responses.
- Validate inputs and return consistent REST API errors.
- Document setup, demo accounts, API routes, AI configuration, and operational assumptions in README.md.
